title: Dark Ascension Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer who claims more power than Innistrad's ghoulcallers.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose ghoulcallers create undead creations.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf master addressed by a Mondronen shaman, asked to gather the howlpack.

entities.name: Hunter's Moon
entities.description: A lunar event said to be nigh, when the howlpack should gather.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city whose walls are said to grow weak.

events.summary: Liliana Vess boasts that she can create something more powerful than Innistrad's ghoulcallers.
events.quote: let me show you what someone with real power can create.

events.summary: A Mondronen shaman urges Tovolar to gather the howlpack as the Hunter's Moon approaches and Thraben's walls weaken.
events.quote: Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak.

relations.note: Tovolar's howlpack threatens Thraben's weakening walls.
